subject: Add prompt when Ctrl-C pressed (#702)
reason: The change adds only an informational printf (plus fflush) to valkey-cli's interactive Ctrl-C handler in pubsub mode; the reconnect logic and all state handling are unchanged. The branch is reachable only when SIGINT is delivered to an interactive valkey-cli REPL session (sigIntHandler is the sole setter of blocking_state_aborted), and the fuzzer's valkey.action.tools harness can only supply argv, stdin, env and files — it cannot send a signal to the running tool, so no experiment can reach the changed line. Since the change alters no server behaviour, no command reply, and no data or control
